summary.headline: MGEN Solutions issues KRW 10bn private convertible bonds (Series 26) with Dec 9, 2026 payment
summary.what_happened: MGEN Solutions Co., Ltd. filed a corrected notice on Nov 25, 2026 for its 26th series of unsecured, private convertible bonds, with a total face value of KRW 10bn, whose payment date was changed from Nov 25, 2026 to Dec 9, 2026. The corrections moved the maturity date to Dec 9, 2029, shifted the conversion period, put option and call option dates, and updated the interest payment schedule accordingly.

key_numbers.label: Surface interest rate / maturity interest rate

summary.why_it_matters: Convertible bonds can be converted into new shares under the stated terms, which may dilute existing shareholders' ownership if conversion occurs. Corrections to issuance terms such as dates and option schedules are typically filed to align the bond terms with the revised payment timing.
